passed_checks.claim: All five home-page profiles returned HTTP 200 and remained on https://chatgpt.com/.
No horizontal document overflow was detected in any profile or round.
Under the Android mobile user-agent at 412x915, sidebar, login, attachment, dictation and send controls exposed 44x44 CSS-pixel boxes.
At 412x520, the signed-out composer and suggestion CTA remained visible without horizontal overflow. A real virtual keyboard was not opened.
The mobile login page displayed provider choices, email input, Continue and Try it first without horizontal overflow; primary provider and Continue controls were 340x44 CSS pixels.
No console or page runtime error was recorded on the public home page in either primary mobile round.
Observed CLS ranged from 0 to 0.0004 across the public profiles.
The event POSTs received successful HTTP 200 or 204 responses before CDP emitted net::ERR_ABORTED; the generic failed-request detector must not treat them as failed delivery.

confirmed_observations.claim: At the same 412x915 viewport, desktop and Android mobile user-agents received materially different signed-out home variants.

evidence.desktop_ua_header: Sidebar + ChatGPT model selector + Log in

confirmed_observations.impact: This confirms a separate mobile-web delivery branch. It is not a defect by itself, but fixes and experiments must be validated on both branches rather than inferred from viewport-only testing.

confirmed_observations.claim: The mobile login page emitted one stable first-party console.error in both rounds.
confirmed_observations.impact: No visible user-task failure is established. Preserve as a low-severity diagnostic finding, not a security or login-failure claim.

rejected_signals.reason: Every recorded event request received HTTP 200 or 204 before the loading-aborted signal. No lifecycle event occurred before capture and no visible failure was observed.
The composer uses a larger container and critical icon buttons are 44x44. Suggestion and legal links require context/spacing review rather than raw 44-pixel counting.
Screenshots show no obstruction; the detected fixed/sticky surface was an ancestor container containing the composer.
The controlled browser matrix found no duplicate visible heading in any profile.

unknowns: Real virtual-keyboard resize, safe-area and browser-chrome interaction.
Authenticated long-chat scrolling, streaming and return-to-latest behaviour.
Attachments, camera, image/file preview and permission recovery.
Search sources, widgets, Projects, Work, custom GPTs and plan-limit states.
TalkBack, browser zoom, external keyboard and switch-control behaviour.
The semantic meaning of the opaque Error object logged by the mobile login bundle.
recommended_next_tests: Map the public login bundle stack through first-party source maps and replace opaque console logging with an explicit error code/message if intentional.
Run an authorised mobile account matrix for long chat, streaming, sidebar history, attachment tray and offline recovery.
Run a real Android Chrome session with virtual keyboard and visualViewport tracing.
Run TalkBack and 200% browser zoom task checks on the primary composer and login path.
verdict_meaning: The signed-out mobile web passes the bounded route, overflow, compact-height, primary-control and event-delivery checks. One repeated public-login console diagnostic remains without demonstrated user impact.
